name: session-improvement-loop
description: Research uncertain decisions and local inference candidates, and independently validate reusable workflow improvements.

interface.shortDescription: Research decisions and validate scoped skill improvements.
interface.longDescription: Portable research synthesis, source-guided local inference comparisons, independent skill improvement, and bounded session review. Preserves the host provider, evidence limits, budgets and operational authority.
defaultPrompt: Research this decision using independent evidence and a shared budget.
Evaluate one evidence-backed improvement to this workflow.
Review recent sessions for reusable improvements.
Compare local inference candidates using hardware-matched evidence and source-specific research checklists.
